title: US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
content:
Fossil fuels are still the biggest source of electricity for hyperscale data centers in the US, a new paper published in the journal Nature Sustainability shows. They likely burn through more electricity collectively than many countries do, resulting in a serious amount of greenhouse gas emissions.
The study homes in on hyperscale facilities - the massive structures spanning millions of square feet that developers are racing to build in large part to support generative AI. Nvidia's board of directors "isn't considering" having Jensen Huang return as CEO, according to a report from CNBC. A source tells the outlet the board "is focused on an investigation into Huang, and is not in discussions to bring him back."

An online petition to bring Huang back as CEO has amassed more than 180,000 signatures, including from major figures like Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and Replit CEO Amjad Masad.

content:
